# Kevin Anugerah Faza

> Kevin Anugerah Faza (also known as Kevin Anugerah) is an AI/ML Engineer based in Surabaya, Indonesia. He builds AI systems end to end, from models to the infrastructure that runs them, with a focus on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), large language models, agentic AI and LLM evaluation. He studies Information Technology (Bachelor of Computer Science) at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), 2023–2027 (expected), GPA 3.80/4.00.

## Experience

- AI Developer Intern, AI Top Trends (Aug 2026 – present): built an evidence-driven AI news intelligence pipeline with source ingestion, deduplication, story clustering, claim/evidence validation, provenance tracking and validation status gates; generates validated Bahasa Indonesia daily summaries.
- Vice Head, Cyber Security and Smart City Laboratory, ITS (Jan 2026 – present): leads data science and AI research; designed and deployed a RAG-based laboratory chatbot with model auto-routing.
- Machine Learning Engineer, Avalon AI (Feb 2024 – present): research on gradient boosting trees, language-model architectures and RAG; authored work on SahabatAI-based RAG for legal contexts.
- AI Engineer Intern, PT PAL Indonesia (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026): built NDA-protected internal AI systems for document knowledge access and conversational business intelligence.
- Assistant Lecturer, ITS (Aug 2024 – Jul 2026): Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning; Data Communications and Computer Network; Database Systems; Algorithms and Programming Techniques.

## Selected projects

- 19MJ AI Career Development & Hiring Platform: AI-powered career development and recruitment platform (React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, Faster-Whisper). https://github.com/nessorrowz/19MJ
- Real-Time Big Data Lakehouse Platform: containerized streaming data platform with medallion layers, automated training, MLflow tracking and API inference (Kafka, Spark, MinIO, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker). https://github.com/Trenttzzz/fp-bigdata-01
- Material Property Prediction: piecewise Gaussian Process Regression; 1st place, final leaderboard score 0.13689.
- Hybrid RAG Knowledge Assistant (NDA): hybrid retrieval, reranking and local LLM inference; 86.67% context recall and 78.89% context precision.
- Executive Data Assistant (NDA): Bahasa Indonesia text-to-SQL over ClickHouse via Telegram; 100% query execution success on hard-level test cases.
